title: Bram and the Horizon
author: Odile Blackwood
blurb: Jonah Blackwood, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
